description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDefaultModifiers, which implements the method to set default modifiers in the Smarty template engine. It contains a class with a public method that modifies the default modifiers property of a Smarty object.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDefaultModifiers
classes.description: Class providing the method to set default modifiers in Smarty templates.

methods.name: setDefaultModifiers
methods.description: Sets the default modifiers for a Smarty template object.
